_derivation_note: Hand-derived from the page's own stated virial-mass-estimator resource model (sigma^2 ~ M/r so dM/M ~= 2*dsigma/sigma; dsigma_kms = sigma_v*dM/(2*M_ref) with sigma_v=20 km/s, M_ref=7000 Msun fixed constants; req_prec_uas = dsigma_kms/(4.74*d_kpc)*1000 with d_kpc=5.2 fixed; n_epochs = max(3, ceil((prec/sqrt(eff_stars)/req_prec_uas)^2))), reimplemented independently in Node and cross-checked to full float precision -- see OCS-FIXWAVE.md FW-4 board note. Both cases land in the feasible/green band with n_epochs floored at the minimum of 3 (search did not find a red/amber combination within the exposed slider ranges -- custom_prec is capped at 200 uas by the hash loader's clamp(1,200), which was not enough to cross the infeasibility threshold at any stars/goal combination tried); documented rather than manufactured via an out-of-range hash value. instr_key is read from the page's own DOM select (not the module state) inside calculate() -- loadHash() sets both, so driving the tool via hash (as a browser would) is required, and a bare state-mutation would not reproduce the real page's behavior.
